messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: runtime-serving-prod canary slices showing sustained latency spike and elevated 5xx (rule: latency > 400ms for 5m). Dashboard: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz
jamie: ACK — paging oncall, jumping in.
sam-runtime: I can see kernel selector falling back to slow path on slice-3 after the wave rollout. Multiple fallback events coincident with batcher window growth.
sam-runtime: logs:
```
[2026-03-17T12:03:12Z] kernel_select: fallback_path=true, reason=affinity_miss
[2026-03-17T12:03:13Z] batcher: queued=1024, window_ms=250
[2026-03-17T12:03:14Z] kv_cache: evictions=87
```
marta: FYI rolled out micro-slice change (commit abc123) ~8m ago; enabled feature flag `adaptive_batch` for canary.
jamie: sounds like a bad interaction between new batcher and kernel affinity. can we flip the flag off for canary ASAP?
marta: on it — running: `/flag adaptive_batch off --env=canary`
devops-bot: command accepted: /flag adaptive_batch off (user marta)
deploy-bot: feature flag `adaptive_batch` disabled on canary pool (10.0.3.*). :white_check_mark:
sam-runtime: quick telemetry: latency median improved 680ms -> 420ms but p95 still elevated; KV churn/throughput drop persists. Recommend rolling back canary image while we debug kernel selector.
jamie: agree. marta, can you kick a rollback and shift traffic back to stable?
marta: initiating rollback — `/deploy rollback rollout-2026-03-17-004`
deploy-bot: rollback started for rollout-2026-03-17-004. estimate 2m. progress: 25% -> 50% -> 100%.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic rebalanced to stable. :white_check_mark:
sam-runtime: post-rollback metrics: median latency 120ms, p95 210ms, error rate back to baseline. kernel fallback events stopped.
nina-sales: CS note: two enterprise customers (acme-inc, brightco) reported intermittent 504s during the window, raised support tickets. I've alerted account reps.
cs-bot: Tickets created: #INC-10234 (acme-inc), #INC-10235 (brightco). CS notified.
jamie: marking incident as P1 mitigated. still need RCA and action items. schedule a postmortem and assign owners.
sam-runtime: root cause hypothesis: adaptive_batch increased batching window under certain load bursts which caused queuing > kernel-affinity threshold; kernel selector misinterpreted affinity signals and chose fallback slow path, leading to KV thrash and throughput collapse. Immediate fixes: revert batcher change in canary and add a guard in kernel selector to avoid fallback on short spikes. I'll open the PRs.
marta: instituting release freeze for micro-slice rollouts for next 24h and locking the canary until fixes validated.
jamie: oncall handoff: @alex-sre please take monitoring for the next 6 hours (12:00-18:00 PST) and escalate if any regressions.
alex-sre: taking handoff. monitoring dashboards and alerts watched. will notify on any anomalies.
jamie: postmortem owner: sam-runtime. deliverable: timeline + root cause + action items + customer impact — due EOW. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
incident-bot: Incident status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity downgraded P1 -> P2 (monitoring). Follow-up task: https://taskboard/redwood/INC-10234
